title: 'Why I make wudu' card
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y3 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Why I make wudu' card)
intro: Lesson 9: Purity and why we make wudu. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Purity in Islam
points: Allah loves those who keep pure
Body, clothes and place of prayer are clean

panels.title: The niyyah
points: Intend in the heart: I am making wudu
No words out loud are needed

keywords.def: purity: being clean inside and out
the washing Allah asks for before prayer

questions.q: Explain why someone with clean hands still makes wudu before salah.
questions.a: Wudu is not only for dirt; Allah commands it to make us pure for prayer.

questions.q: Name three things that must be clean for salah.
Write a short 'Why I make wudu' card on the pupil PDF: three sentences using taharah, niyyah and salah.
questions.a: For example: I make wudu to be pure for salah. My niyyah is in my heart. Allah loves those who keep pure.

questions.q: Extend: which ayah tells us how to make wudu?
Stretch: what does 'purity is half of faith' teach us?
questions.a: Purity is a big part of being a Muslim, not a small extra.
A) To be pure for salah. Wudu is worship: Allah commands it before prayer (5:6).

questions.q: Think again: what is the difference between clean and pure?
questions.a: Pure means ready for worship as Allah taught, with niyyah.
